text: Osmund Saddler intended to use his telepathic control over an infected Ashley Graham to seize nuclear launch codes and infect the U.S. federal leadership.
Jack Krauser viewed the Las Plagas project as a tool to reclaim his lost honor as a soldier, while Ada Wong viewed it purely as a valuable commodity.
Ada Wong intended to use the Plaga sample as leverage, recognizing that delivering it to her employer could enable a global catastrophe.
